**Potential1200 1.0.0**: the first release.

That late-80s 12-bit drum sound on your MPC: 8 faders, 8 pads, and every sound sampled at 26 kHz into 12 bits, with drop-sample pitch, the classic filters and the 45 > 33 trick.

- **Sounds** from your one-shots (a `DRUM ONE SHOTS` folder, which MPC TOOLS 1.5.9 can make for you) or a break from your `DRUM BREAKS LIBRARY`, chopped across the pads.
- **PERFORM** (8 faders), **PROGRAM**, **KIT** and **SETUP** pages, plus the on-screen manual.
- **SAVE KIT** writes the pads as an MPC drum program.
- Four looks: the new **Vintage**, plus Print Plate, Night Rack and Colour Block.

**Which zip?** MPC OS 3.10.1 or later: `-akai-vst2.zip`. Older MPC OS 3.x with the community set-up: `-mpc-armv7.zip`. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potential1200/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
